description: One door for harness and tool installs: oh harness install and oh tool install are the only way a harness or tool enters the sandbox; boot provisioning, install.* keys, persist flags, and off-ramps are retired.

userStories.title: Catalogs and CLI verbs expose one door
userStories.description: As an operator, I want oh harness and oh tool to install only when I ask, with no default set and no persist flags, so that the verb is the only way a harness or tool enters the sandbox.
acceptanceCriteria: harnesses/catalog.ts: HarnessKind = "installable" | "on-demand"; harnessKey, defaultHarnesses, optionalHarnesses removed; installArgv, verifyArgv, pins, shas unchanged
tools/catalog.ts: ToolKind = "baked-in" | "installable"; toolKey, defaultTools removed; pins and shas unchanged

harness.ts, tool.ts, cli.ts: no --persist-only/--no-persist/--defaults; oh tool install keeps --yes; install = probe -> install -> report with no oh.json write; no ENABLED column or enabled field; no error text promises a later boot install
git grep of the switch strings under .oh/cli returns only runtime-catalog.test.ts
harness-catalog.test.ts, harness.test.ts, tool.test.ts, tool-catalog.test.ts assert the one-door shape; install-flag-persistence.test.ts deleted
Typecheck passes
npm --prefix .oh/cli run build succeeds
Tests pass
userStories.notes: commit 56fccb4b; typecheck 0, build 0, pnpm test 960/960 with SANDBOX_SSH unset, D4 grep under .oh/cli returns only runtime-catalog.test.ts:85

userStories.title: install.* leaves the config surface
userStories.description: As an operator, I want no install section in oh.json, the wizard, the installer, or the migrator, so that there is no second place that decides what gets installed.
acceptanceCriteria: oh-config.ts: install removed from OhConfig, defaultOhConfig, validator, OH_CONFIG_FIELDS; unknown keys in an existing oh.json still tolerated
env-file.ts: INSTALL_FIELDS, installFieldPath, isInstallFlagEnabled, setInstallFlag and legacy INSTALL_* importers deleted; CONFIG_FIELD_BY_ENV_KEY keeps only DOCKER_SOCKET
init.ts: Optional installs step removed; steps renumbered
template oh.json carries no install section
install.sh: _opt_install block deleted; closing banner lists claude-code, codex, pi, herdr, cloudflared install lines
migrate-harness-yaml.sh: install.* mappings dropped; harness-yaml-migration.sh probe adjusted
env-file.test.ts, init.test.ts, oh-config.test.ts, install-prereqs.test.ts updated
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: commit 56fccb4b; oh-config tolerates a stale install object; init wizard renumbered 1-4

userStories.title: Boot provisions nothing
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a fresh sandbox to boot without installing any harness or tool, so that the home volume holds only what I put there.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/scripts/provision-defaults.sh deleted
entrypoint.sh: provisioning block deleted; herdr hint prints oh tool install herdr when absent; no boot step assumes herdr exists
sandbox-healthcheck.sh: provision-failed marker block deleted; sandbox-healthcheck.test.ts updated
provision-python.sh and docker-compose.yml start_period untouched
git grep -nE 'OH_PROVISION|provision-defaults|provision-failed' -- .devcontainer .oh/scripts returns nothing
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: commit 55ceece1; provision-defaults.sh deleted, entrypoint block and healthcheck marker gone

userStories.title: Verifiers, probes, and CI prove the one-door state and bite
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the boot smoke, the image verifier, the probe suite, and CI to fail if anything installs at boot or a switch returns, so that the refactor cannot regress silently.
acceptanceCriteria: sandbox-boot-smoke.sh: every kind==installable entry reports installed==false after a fresh boot for both catalogs; fails when a catalog has no installable entry; sandbox-boot-smoke.test.ts updated
verify-sandbox-image.sh: check_nothing_baked covers every entry with an installArgv; its tests updated
default-provisioning.sh replaced by harness-one-door.sh with the PASS/REGRESSION/SKIPPED contract; fault injection on a scratch copy yields REGRESSION
provision-marker-fail-closed.sh deleted; tool-catalog-boundary.sh, tailscale-tool-boundary.sh, sandbox-boot-guard-ci.sh, runtime-preflight-gate.sh pass
sandbox-compatibility.yml: OH_PROVISION_DEFAULTS and --no-persist removed, jq filters select installable; sandbox-boot-guard.yml comment rewritten
bash .oh/skills/eval/run.sh exits 0 with no new REGRESSION
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: commit 55ceece1 + 8c898945; harness-one-door probe bites on 8 injected faults; eval run exit 0

userStories.title: Docs and root context describe only the door
userStories.description: As a new operator, I want every document to tell me to run oh harness install <id> or oh tool install <id>, so that I never look for a flag, a key, or a first-boot install that no longer exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Pattern applied across docs/, README.md, .oh/cli/README.md, .oh/install/banner.sh, docs/rfcs/rfc-brain-hands-boundary.md:113, .oh/skills/t3/references/tailscale-mobile.md:86, .oh/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md:70

CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry <=250 chars linking #948
git grep of the switch strings over docs README.md AGENTS.md .oh/cli/README.md .oh/install .oh/skills returns nothing
docs/harnesses/overview.md and docs/installation.md read as one door end to end
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: commit a6a00674; D9 greps clean; overview.md and installation.md read as one door

userStories.title: Before and after evidence from child sandboxes

acceptanceCriteria: Before leg from ghcr.io/mifunedev/openharness:latest shows provisioning of claude-code, codex, pi, herdr, cloudflared and both lists installed (D1)
After leg from the PR-head image shows no provisioning lines, every installable entry INSTALLED no, healthcheck passes (D2)
Inside the after child: oh tool install herdr && herdr --version and oh harness install pi && pi --version exit 0 (D3)
verify-sandbox-image.sh PASS on the after image (D5)
Both children torn down with down -v; no oh-child-* container or volume remains
Excerpts recorded in evidence.md and the PR body
Typecheck passes
